judge.rationale: The candidate did not implement any production code at all, producing only a `.lore/dod.md` planning file and a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversation-list.acceptance.test.ts`). None of the required source files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, docs, or specs) were modified. Furthermore, the candidate's tests don't even compile or make sense against the issue requirements: `SessionSummary` is imported from `../../types/session.js` instead of `sessionStore.js`, `createHarness` never passes any `sessionStore` or `history` options to `createMessageHandler`, and the candidate explicitly ignored the issue's amendment requiring composite `{updatedAt, sessionId}` cursors for `before`.
